chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام, when he intended to travel, would say:
"O Allah, clear our way, make our travel good, and magnify our well-being."

key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; a direct invocation to God
key_terms.تَسْيِيرَنَا: our travelling or movement on the journey
key_terms.خَلِّ: make clear or free of obstacles

ai.seo_question: What du'a did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say when intending to travel?
ai.summary: This hadith records a supplication of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام to be recited when setting out on a journey. It asks Allah for an open path, ease and goodness in travel, and abundant well-being.
